Evidence: the append predates the file's first commit (f467891c 2026-11-08 already reads 21/23), so the in-archive same-window annotation is the record; per-line face and uniqueness counted in R3212 - qa/probe-R3212.log, qa/probe-R3212b.log, qa/probe-R3212d.log, pinned by AC-CEN5.
